original.description: A cased rotor is fed charge through a handcrank and supplemented by solar heat. Its scratched metal surfaces vibrate at ground frequency.

source_shape: Rectangular raised upper frame with inset horizontal element/open gap; lower field has short left marks, a large lower-right detail-colored circular perimeter and central primary point, plus a low full-width primary rail.

palette.primary: c from TileColor across body/top/control marks/axial center
palette.detail: W on source circular wheel perimeter only
palette.glyph: ColorString W belongs to glyph fallback and does not turn whole tiled body gold.
palette.rule: Preserve actual c/W roles independently in neutral artwork. Gold construction key is wheel ownership, not paint baked into texture.

native_state: One fixed Furniture/generator.bmp body tile. No child operational tile loop or rotor animation declared. SolarArray and Circuitry installed code handles charge/production and does not declare a new body tile. Do not invent spinning crank, vibration frames, on/off paint or extra solar-panel states. Inherited unpowered status indicator remains native UI/status fallback; rare Animated1/15000 RailedMechanism retains native fallback.

findings: SolarArray IPoweredPart participates in charge production at blueprint ChargeRate15; source ChargeUse defaults0. No Tile/Render override in this class.
Circuitry StartCharge sets Charge/IncomingCharge and ActiveTurn. No Tile/Render override in this class; charge display/flow remains native.
native_code_study.boundary: Static definition/code study only, not native replacement acceptance. Description establishes a handcrank, not a new animation contract.

native_behavior: Source SolarArray15, CircuitryStartCharge1000, electrical producer1000, security0PowerSwitch, AV15/HP300. Inherited solid non-takeable15000weight inorganic metal/occluding RenderLayer7 installation. Native solar/charge/grid/switch/examine/tinker, rare Animated state and sounds remain untouched.

reference.role: Actual VTE override of Core ChemfuelPoweredGenerator: restrained case/cylindrical metal highlights, wear and shallow cardinal map volume only. No large donor cylinders, caps, fuel tank/color,2x2footprint or fuel gameplay copied.
reference.equivalence: Partial machinery finish reference, not source generator geometry.

construction.camera: One fixed cardinal map face with parallel case edges and small bevels, no three-quarter cabinet/diagonal yaw.
construction.source_supported: Upper rectangular frame/inset bar, four short left marks, lower-right ring/central point, low base rail, c primary/W circular detail. Description supports cased rotor and handcrank.
construction.authored: Sparse native glyph lines are interpreted as landmarks of a filled lower casing. Panel thickness, closed casing surface, recessed small marks, axle/crank coupling and restrained top-module depth are authored, not native fields. Actual upper opening is left transparent; no bucket, external solar wing, fuel bottle or cable bank added.
construction.coverage_difference: Lower casing interior is intentionally reconstructed behind source wheel/marks because description says cased rotor. This is not exact native-alpha upscaling; source landmark positions/outline/roles remain anchor. Wheel interior shows primary casing/axle; no foreign background fill.
construction.dimension_provenance: Authored source-cell coordinates, not physical lengths recovered from weight or donor texture bounds.

frame.rule: One full source-cell mapping for complete casing/wheel/ownership. No individual bounds centering or extra direction binding.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation: native solar/charge/grid/switch/physics/visibility, inherited status indicator, rare Animated fallback and save/load; no native activation.
